EssenceHint.authority: force, will, power that shapes reality
EssenceHint.nature: living things, plants, beasts, the bond with the land
EssenceHint.empathy: other people, community, the ties between them
EssenceHint.stillness: the inner self, secrets, what we keep deep inside
EssenceHint.imagination: the future, art, creation, new ideas

MediumPrompt.authority: Can't bring themselves to stand up for themselves, and it hurts.
MediumPrompt.nature: Feels smothered by technology or city life.
MediumPrompt.empathy: Keeps people at arm's length, struggles to connect.
MediumPrompt.stillness: Lives for others' opinions instead of their own heart.
MediumPrompt.imagination: Bored by routine, lacking creative spark.
MediumPrompt.wisdom: Doubts their knowledge (or trusts it too much) and lacks perspective.

Consequence.rush: Rush Hour: +1 or −1 per missing Essence

Witch.realizationHint: At the end of the Day: which Trait mattered? Should it be rewritten? Which Essence does your Witch want to study, and how?
Witch.studyMethodPlaceholder: A grimoire, a mentor, on their own…
Witch.MagicRule: For 1 Magic point from the Fount, after a roll: turn a die into {essence} ({n}), or turn a {essence} die into any Essence.
Witch.usedHint: Tick when this Trait came into play during the Day

Cafe.incidentHint: Countdown to a Magical Incident: at 0, the next Moment played is a Magical Incident.
Cafe.decorationsHint: Each Witch adds a piece of furniture or decoration that suits them; the Guide goes last.
Cafe.pantryHint: Each Ingredient captures an Essence. A Beverage is made from 3 Ingredients (the same one may be used more than once).
Cafe.name: Name of the Café
Cafe.pantryFoot: Each Beverage is composed of three magical Ingredients, besides its mundane elements.
Cafe.describeVenue: Describe the venue and its distinctive features
Cafe.momentsHint: Fount: {magic} Magic · Vibe {vibe}/6 · Magical Incident in {incident}

Moment.narrativeHint: To add a detail to the scene: roll one or more dice and interpret the Essences. Chat command: /essence 2
Moment.openingHint: Working alone: each Witch makes a test. Each Favorable outcome gives +1 Vibe, each Unfavorable −1.
Moment.togetherHint: One Witch leads and rolls all the dice; each adds their Trait dice. Anyone may use their Magic on any die.
Moment.rushHint: The Guide rolls 1d6 + 1d6 per Witch: these are the Essences to get by working together. Favorable: +1 Vibe; Unfavorable: −1 per missing Essence.
Moment.mediumHint: The Guide plays the Medium and secretly rolls 3 Essences. The Witches may interact {n} times (1 + Vibe), then brew the Beverage.
Moment.umeHint: Preliminary objectives (one test each), then often a Spell cast together. On failure, the Incident countdown drops.
Moment.endDayHint: Moves on to the next Day and recalls the Realization questions.

UME.Confirm: The U.M.E. went wrong: reduce the Magical Incident countdown by 1?
UME.Failed: The U.M.E. went wrong, people will talk…

EndDay.Title: End of Day {day}
EndDay.Q1: Which Trait of each Witch was crucial today? Do the events justify rewriting it, and how?
EndDay.Q2: Which Essence does each Witch want to study? With which book, which mentor, or alone — and how?

Medium.Label: Medium
Medium.inspirationHint: Roll an Essence Die to imagine who this Medium is
Medium.promptsHint: Prompts to play the Medium according to the Essences rolled:
Medium.CountdownLeft: {name}: {n} more interaction(s) before wanting their Beverage.

Beverage.Title: Brew a Beverage
Beverage.Hint: Pick 3 Ingredients from the pantry. Each correct Essence gives 1 Magic; the perfect Beverage gives 1d6 additional Magic.
Beverage.Perfect: Perfect Beverage! The bond with the Fount blossoms (+{bonus}).
Beverage.Waiting: The Beverage steams on the counter… The Guide serves it to the Medium.

Spell.altEssences: Essences if conditions are not met

Test.Title: {name}'s test
Test.TargetsHint: Set by the Guide. Leave everything at 0 for a roll without a goal.

Coven.Title: Working together
Coven.Hint: The leading Witch rolls 1d6 + their Trait; every other checked Witch adds their Trait dice.

Rush.Title: Rush Hour!
Rush.Hint: The Guide rolls 1d6, plus 1d6 for each Witch in play (Guide included).
Rush.Next: Interpret the customers' mood, then work together to get these Essences.

Magic.Title: Fount Magic
Magic.Hint: 1 Magic point ({magic} left): turn a die into your Essence, or turn a die of your Essence into any other. Describe how the Magic shows!

Warn.NoGM: No Guide (GM) connected to validate this action.
Warn.NoCafe: No Café: create a Café actor.
Warn.FountEmpty: The Fount has run dry! It may be extinguished forever…
Warn.Incident: The next Moment will be a Magical Incident!
Warn.NotEnoughMagic: The Fount doesn't have enough Magic left.
Warn.NotParticipant: None of your Witches is part of this test.
Warn.IllegalMagic: Impossible: turn a die into your Essence, or a die of your Essence into another.
Warn.NotYours: Only the roller or the Guide can apply the consequence.
Warn.NotEnoughDoses: Not enough doses for this Beverage.
Warn.NoMedium: No Medium: the Guide must create one.
Warn.NoDesires: This Medium's sought Essences haven't been rolled.

Settings.ShowFountHint: Small banner at the top of the screen: Magic, Vibe and Incident countdown of the coven's Café.
